explanation: OEIS A238281 conjecture (ii): for n > 4 there is a positive integer k < prime(n) such that (kn,(k+1)n), ((k+1)n,(k+2)n), ((k+2)n,(k+3)n) contain the same number of primes, i.e. π(kn), π((k+1)n), π((k+2)n), π((k+3)n) form a 4-term AP. The Lean statement asks for 0 < k < nth Prime (n−1) = prime(n) with the two consecutive π-differences equal, i.e. the AP condition, which the source itself gives as the equivalent formulation. Faithful.
